This pass. Fork the platform work out of the pinned upstream, get the existing image building and booting here, confirm the determinism claim rather than inheriting it, and publish the artifact — which upstream builds and discards. This bridge aims only at telos/it-actually-boots. It carries no new verification: the payload is the upstream trivial exported function, and the assurance the image carries is exactly the assurance upstream's carried.

```day-bridge
{"telos":"it-actually-boots","have":["upstream-source"],"plan":{"seq":[{"atom":"upstream-pin"},{"atom":"platform-fork"},{"atom":"baseline-build"},{"atom":"boot-gate"},{"atom":"determinism-check"},{"atom":"artifact-publication"}]}}
```

This pass. Fork the platform work out of the pinned upstream, get the existing image building and booting here, confirm the determinism claim rather than inheriting it, record what actually happened, and publish the artifact — which upstream builds and discards. This bridge aims only at telos/it-actually-boots. It carries no new verification: the payload is the upstream trivial exported function, and the assurance the image carries is exactly the assurance upstream's carried.

```day-bridge
{"telos":"it-actually-boots","have":["upstream-source"],"plan":{"seq":[{"atom":"upstream-pin"},{"atom":"platform-fork"},{"atom":"baseline-build"},{"atom":"boot-gate"},{"atom":"determinism-check"},{"atom":"record-reproduction"},{"atom":"artifact-publication"}]}}
```
